result.title: Attacking Tabular Foundation Models: An Experimental Taxonomy of Context Poisoning and Test-Time Evasion
result.summary: Tabular foundation models condition predictions on labeled examples supplied at inference time, creating an attack surface that differs from conventional model training. We study four manipulation families (label flipping, backdoor context poisoning, clean-label context selection, and test-time evasion) and organize them by attack stage, label consistency, and distributional realism. TabPFN-2.5, TabICL, and XGBoost are evaluated on CIC-IDS2017 and N-BaIoT using a common preprocessing and evaluation pipeline. Backdoor context poisoning provides strong targeted control over the in-context models with little change in clean accuracy, whereas selecting real, correctly labeled boundary-crowding rows causes no systematic accuracy degradation up to a 20% bias fraction. A simplified surrogate-transfer constrained PGD attack inspired by, but not equivalent to, CAPGD also produces test-time evasion, outperforming equal-budget random noise in most settings. The comparison shows that attack effectiveness depends strongly on both where manipulation occurs and how much freedom the attacker has to alter the data.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文为表格基础模型（TabPFN-2.5、TabICL、XGBoost）建立上下文投毒与测试时规避的攻击分类体系，并在 CIC-IDS2017 与 N-BaIoT 上以统一流程评测标签翻转、后门上下文投毒、干净标签上下文选择与测试时规避四类操纵的效果差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在推理期改写或在原样保留标签的前提下挑选输入证据、再观察精度变化」的探测方式，可能为 VLM 中视觉证据筛选是否真正被使用、上下文依赖强弱提供评价借鉴，但表格域与多模态场景差距较大，可供核查。
